description: This Java source file defines the `VersionChecker` class responsible for retrieving version information from a remote URL, comparing it with current application versions, and prompting the user to update if necessary. It manages version checks for components like the console and firmware, and displays warnings for critical issues.

classes.name: VersionChecker
classes.description: A singleton class that checks and compares software/component versions with server recommendations, and shows update warnings and critical issue alerts.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a background thread to perform version reading and processing from the server.

methods.name: readAndProcess
methods.description: Reads version data from a remote URL, parses it, updates internal state, and displays warnings or alerts if needed.

methods.name: parseNotNull
methods.description: Parses a string into an integer with error handling; throws exception if input is null.

methods.name: showUpdateWarningIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays a GUI warning prompting the user to update a component if the latest version is newer than current.

methods.name: getPaneParent
methods.description: Returns the parent component for dialog display, usually the main JFrame.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the VersionChecker.

methods.name: onFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Processes firmware version string, compares with server recommendation, and shows warnings if needed.
